text: …　…　と　おもった　けど　にもつが　いっぱい　だから　＊は　また　こんど　ですね

structure.jp: …　…　と　おもった　けど
にもつが　いっぱい　だから
＊は　また　こんど　ですね

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up what was thought; here it points back to what he was about to do. と おもった = 'that's what I thought'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts of a sentence with 'but'. おもった けど = 'I thought so, but'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what comes next, like 'so'. いっぱい だから = 'it is full, so'.
